title: All About Growing
checkpoint: Reception Summer 1, week 1 — Phase 4: CVCC words: two consonant sounds together at the end (no new sounds)
note_for_grown_ups: Non-fiction, Phase 3 complete, 47-sound stage (ow, oi, ear just added). Simple true facts about growing vegetables, told through Ned.

pages.illustration: Ned the duckling digging with his bill in dark soil in a vegetable patch.

pages.text: Ned pops a seed in the soil.
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling dropping a small round seed into a hole in the soil.

pages.text: The seed sits down in the soil.
pages.illustration: Close view of the small seed resting at the bottom of the hole, soil pressed gently over it.

pages.text: Sun is on the soil. Rain is on the soil.
pages.illustration: A split scene: bright sun warming the soil on one side, light rain falling on it on the other.

pages.text: A root digs down in the soil.
pages.illustration: A cut-away view under the soil showing a thin root growing down from the seed.
A tiny green shoot poking up out of the soil into the sunshine.
A tall, leafy vegetable plant standing in the vegetable patch, much bigger than the first shoot.

pages.text: Ned has a good bit to munch.
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling happily nibbling a piece of vegetable pulled from the patch.
